name: Castor
personality: Devout follower of Aurora who trained his son in combat.
story: Before Cai's birth he tried to elope with the goddess Aurora; granted amnesty until Cai turned 15, he was imprisoned on that birthday, which drives Cai into the Heroic Games. He fights as a guest in Cai's Path Chapter 2, 'Road to the Capital' (Defending the Carriage). His final words are 'Cai... Please... Look after your mother.'
tierNotes: Guest unit; not ranked in any tier list found.

build.notes: Guest-only unit; use his Tempest Spear combat art and Guardian bulk to protect the carriage while Cai's team scores kills.
